_doc: Battlegroups (docs/FEATURES.md 3.4), picked before the match. 'exclude' removes units from production; 'support' lists the off-map support the group can call.

nc.name: Armoured Battlegroup
nc.text: Tanks, IFVs and heavy artillery. No helicopters.

nc.name: Air-Mobile Infantry
nc.text: Helicopters, infantry and paradrops. No main battle tanks or SPGs.

nc.name: Recon and Fires
nc.text: Drones, recon, SPGs and attack helicopters. No tanks, no transport helicopters.

ec.name: Tank Regiment
ec.text: Tanks, IFVs and massed artillery. No helicopters.

ec.name: Air Assault Brigade
ec.text: Helicopters, infantry and paradrops. No main battle tanks or SPGs.

ec.name: Electronic Warfare Group
ec.text: EW, recon, SPGs and assault helicopters. No tanks, no transport helicopters.
